en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahi, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al A’ala Bin Al Fazeyl who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The Penalty (Hadd) of the sodomist is like the Penalty (Hadd) of the adulterer’. And heasws said: ‘If he was married, would be stoned, or else whipped’.
